purpose: R61 independent construction-parameter holdout; synthetic, no outcome selection; not a claim of unseen generator families

source_rules.partition_layout: pid0..P-2 each small_bytes; pidP-1 big_bytes; same layout in all operators
source_rules.insert_chunks: ascending operator then ascending pid, split each partition into chunks <=1048576; key=pid; exactly one SWITCH per operator immediately after its last INSERT
source_rules.phase_overlap: for phase_overlap mode only, after each operator SWITCH emit its first quarter of probes before building the next operator; all remaining probes use the common schedule
source_rules.seed_semantics: Python random.Random(seed), used only for per-operator permutation of small partition IDs and optional key lifting; no method outputs read
source_rules.key_lifting: key=pid (no lifting required); semantic distinctness must be checked, not only raw hash

base_modes.hot: pid0 for three of every four local probe indices, pid1 otherwise
base_modes.scan: permuted small IDs followed by big pid, cyclic
base_modes.big: big pid for seven of every eight probes, permuted small[i//8 mod(P-1)] otherwise
base_modes.cycle: permuted small IDs then big pid, cyclic
base_modes.alternate: big pid on even local indices and permuted small[(i//2) mod(P-1)] on odd indices

source_rules.train_modes: for case index j and operator o select base_modes[(j+o) mod6] from ordered list [hot,scan,big,small,cycle,alternate], stationary for whole case; ordinary round-robin schedule except phase_overlap
source_rules.holdout_modes: each operator first half uses base_modes[(case_index+o) mod6], second half uses base_modes[(case_index+o+3) mod6]; family is composition/reversal of known base modes, not wholly unrelated
source_rules.schedule: normally round-robin op0..K-1 over unfinished operators; burst_mix/interleave_reverse use blocks of8 per operator first half of remaining global probes, then block1 in reversed operator order; deterministic quotas respected
source_rules.metadata: save exact parameters, seed, source hashes, per-op declared/realized counts, mode segments, phase overlap, raw and modulo-P semantic hashes, validity audit
source_rules.no_outcome_filter: all8 cases must be retained regardless of method performance; invalid input may be repaired with a logged recipe version, never silently replaced for scores

train.use: new training pool for later rounds; not appended mid-R61

holdout.use: open only after R61 model freeze; then label observed development holdout for subsequent tuning
